About - Danis Zaidan Danis Zaidan Z Get In Touch arrow_forward menu Danis Zaidan About Me A Frontend Developer Hello, Salam Kenal 👋 My name is Danis Zaidan, an enthusiastic Frontend Developer with 5+ years of experience in React and Next.js. I build high quality, user focused digital experiences that drive business results. Passionate about continuous learning and exploring ideas that balance design, functionality, and efficiency. My interest started in high school with Blogger templates, experimenting with HTML and CSS. That curiosity evolved into a passion for programming and UI UX design. An inspiring professor once told me, “Don't make it difficult for the User” taught me the importance of creating accessible and intuitive solutions that truly meet people's needs. Experiences 5+ years experience in web development industry. Universitas Terbuka Frontend Developer Universitas Terbuka (UT) is Indonesia's public open and distance learning university, serving hundreds of thousands of students across Indonesia and abroad. At UT, I work on a complex tax-related web application with dynamic rule based forms for accurate data entry and verification. Designed and built the front-end codebase architecture from scratch with a clear folder structure, state management strategy, and consistent component patterns, ensuring a modular, scalable, and maintainable codebase for long-term development. Implemented a complex tax form with dynamic and conditional logic, including formula calculations involving multiple inputs, to ensure calculation accuracy and reduce potential user errors. Collaborated closely with backend engineers to design and integrate APIs, align business flows, and ensure efficient data communication between frontend and backend. Worked with UI/UX designers to translate designs into a scalable component architecture, while proposing and implementing design improvements to enhance visual quality, usability, and accessibility. Wrote code by applying best practices, clean code principles, and separation of concerns to maintain code quality, clarity, and long-term maintainability. Performed debugging, bug fixing, and performance optimization to keep the application responsive and stable, even under complex calculation scenarios and heavy user input. July 2025 - Present Tangerang, Indonesia See More arrow_downward Telkom Indonesia Frontend Developer Telkom Indonesia is the country's largest state-owned telecommunications company, serving over 150M+ customers and playing a key role in Indonesia's digital transformation. Key Projects: Data Exchange, My IndiHome, Smart Profile, Smart Capex. Designed, developed, and maintained scalable frontend solutions using the React.js ecosystem, ensuring high performance and maintainability. Conducted unit testing, debugging, and performance optimizations to enhance application stability and efficiency. Led the frontend development team, providing mentorship and guidance to ensure best coding practices and responsiveness across all devices. Developed and enhanced internal dashboards for data management, streamlining internal processes and improving operational efficiency. Collaborated closely with backend engineers to integrate new features seamlessly, ensuring efficient API communication and data flow. Worked alongside UI/UX designers to translate wireframes into reusable and scalable component-based architectures. Revamped the website interface, leading to an improved user experience and improved user interaction. Feb 2020 - Mar 2025 Bandung, Indonesia See More arrow_downward Galajidar Theta Optima FullStack Developer Intern Galajidar Theta Optima is a Bandung-based software house specializing in software development, web solutions, and enterprise solutions. Collaborated closely with the design team to translate UI/UX concepts into responsive and interactive code. Developed a dynamic company profile website and a CMS dashboard using PHP, Materialize, and MySQL to streamline content and data management. Contributed to technical discussions, providing suggestions for feature improvements and system enhancements. Jun 2019 - Aug 2019 Bandung, Indonesia See More arrow_downward Education Telkom University, Diploma of Software Engineering 2017 - 2020. Casual Gamer My favorite games are AAA RPGs, best enjoyed with a controller while relaxing and enjoying the beautiful scenery. Currently, I'm playing Elden Ring on Steam. WatchLur - Danis Zaidan Danis Zaidan Z Get In Touch arrow_forward menu WatchLur Design, Development Entertainment Description Watchlur is a movie database website similar to IMDb or TMDB. Originally, this project was created in collaboration with Arkan for the web design competition at Telkom DEVORIA Season 1. My role was UI/UX Designer & Frontend Developer, while Arkan focused on Frontend Development & PWA. Later, in late 2024 - now (this project is still work in progress), I decided to redesign and rebuild the project from scratch as a way to explore design concepts, learning, and enhance my skills in Next.js 14 App Router, Server Component, TypeScript, React Query, animations, and more. Detail Project Role UI/UX Designer, Frontend Developer Team Danis Zaidan Technology Next.js , Typescript , Tailwind CSS , The Movie Database (TMDB) API , TanStack Query , Figma Live Site watchlur.vercel.app arrow_forward Explore Movies and TV Series Find millions of movies and TV series in our database movie library. Get inspired with now playing, top rated, popular, and many more. Media Gallery Organizes and displays trailers, videos, and images related to a movie or TV series, allowing users to explore videos and images in a visually engaging format. Advanced Search Allows users to refine movie and TV series searches using filters and sorting options. It also categorizes results into Movies, TV Series, and People, making it easier and find relevant content. Movie Overview & Details This feature provides key movie information, including title, rating, duration, genres, and synopsis, along with production details such as director, writers, budget, revenue, etc. Cast & Crew View the full list of actors, directors, and crew members for each movie or TV show. Get details about their roles and explore their filmography. More Features to Explore Loading Effect & Caching Watchlur uses skeleton loading for a smooth experience while fetching data. With TanStack Query caching, previously loaded data is stored, reducing refetching and speeding up page loads. Hover Detail Card Watchlur uses skeleton loading for a smooth experience while fetching data. With TanStack Query caching, previously loaded data is stored, reducing refetching and speeding up page loads. Responsive Design Watchlur is fully responsive, ensuring an optimal viewing experience across all devices, from desktops to tablets and smartphones, with a seamless and adaptive layout. Infinite Scroll Enables seamless browsing and smooth experience of movie and TV series lists by dynamically loading more content as users scroll. It utilizes useInfiniteQuery from TanStack Query. Watch Provider The Watch Provider feature helps users find where to stream, rent, or buy movies with direct links from JustWatch via TMDB. Watch Trailer The Trailer Preview feature lets users watch official movie trailers directly via embedded YouTube videos. Contact Have any project in mind? Alrizan Dashboard - Danis Zaidan Danis Zaidan Z Get In Touch arrow_forward menu Alrizan Dashboard Development Business Description A CMS dashboard for efficient and realtime product management and social media integration. Alrizan Dashboard is a powerful content management system (CMS) designed to manage product data efficiently while integrating seamless social media and online shop sharing. With a Firestore Realtime Database, it ensures fast and organized data handling. The system features a minimalist, fully responsive Material Design and supports Google Login with multi-level user management. Product management is enhanced with automated product name recommendations, auto generated descriptions and hashtags, smart detection of incomplete product data, auto-compression image optimization, and easy social media sharing. For media management, it provides lightbox image zoom, batch image downloads, and centralized social media URL management, ensuring a streamlined workflow for store owners. Detail Project Role Frontend Developer Team Danis Zaidan Technology Next.js , MUI (Material UI) , Redux Toolkit , React Hook Form , Compressor.js , Figma Live Site alrizan.vercel.app arrow_forward Product Management Manage product data efficiently with options to add, edit, delete, and share products. The page displays product details, galleries, posting status, brand, gender, clothing type, color, and size. A completion status indicator helps track missing product details. Login with Google Quick and secure access to the dashboard with Google authentication. Product Management Update details, manage images, and link to social media & marketplaces easily. Share Product Easily share product details, pricing, materials, and images with a copyable text and gallery download feature. Brand Management Manage brand data easily with options to add, edit, and delete brands. Search functionality allows quick access to specific brands. Contact Have any project in mind? SmartCapex is a tool designed to visualize and track Capital Expenditure (CapEx) for Telkom's network expansion and maintenance, optimizing traffic and capacity through real-time data and analytics.
